title: Unveiling Anoikis-related genes: A breakthrough in the prognosis of bladder cancer.
authors: Jiang, Shen; Yang, Xiping; Lin, Yang; Liu, Yunfei; Tran, Lisa Jia; Zhang, Jing; Qiu, Chengjun; Ye, Fangdie; Sun, Zhou
one_liner_zh: 该文基于转录组和机器学习构建膀胱癌失巢凋亡相关预后模型，仅涉及转录因子分析且无蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Bladder cancer (BLCA) is a prevalent malignancy worldwide. Anoikis remains a new form of cell death. It is necessary to explore Anoikis-related genes in the prognosis of BLCA. METHODS: We obtained RNA expression profiles from the The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) and Gene Expression Omnibus databases for dimensionality reduction analysis and isolated epithelial cells, T cells and fibroblasts for copy number variation analysis, pseudotime analysis and transcription factor analysis based on R package. We integrated machine-learning algorithms to develop the artificial intelligence-derived prognostic signature (AIDPS). RESULTS: The performance of AIDPS with clinical indicators was stable and robust in predicting BLCA and showed better performance in every validation dataset compared to other models. Mendelian randomization analysis was conducted. Single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) sites of rs3100578 (HK2) and rs66467677 (HSP90B1) exhibited significant correlation of bladder problem (not cancer) and bladder cancer, whereasSNP sites of rs3100578 (HK2) and rs947939 (BAD) had correlation between bladder stone and bladder cancer. The immune infiltration analysis of the TCGA-BLCA cohort was calculated via the ESTIMATE (i.e. Estimation of STromal and Immune cells in MAlignantTumours using Expression data) algorithm which contains stromal, immune and estimate scores. We also found significant differences in the IC(50) values of Bortezomib_1191, Docetaxel_1007, Staurosporine_1034 and Rapamycin_1084 among the high- and low-risk groups. CONCLUSIONS: In conclusion, these findings indicated Anoikis-related prognostic genes in BLCA and constructed an innovative machine-learning model of AIDPS with high prognostic value for BLCA.
abstract_zh: 背景：膀胱癌（BLCA）是全球常见的恶性肿瘤。失巢凋亡（Anoikis）是一种新型的细胞死亡形式。探讨失巢凋亡相关基因在膀胱癌预后中的作用十分必要。方法：我们从癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）和基因表达综合数据库获取RNA表达谱数据进行降维分析，并基于R包分离出上皮细胞、T细胞和成纤维细胞，用于拷贝数变异分析、伪时间分析和转录因子分析。我们整合机器学习算法，开发了人工智能衍生的预后特征（AIDPS）。结果：AIDPS结合临床指标在预测膀胱癌方面表现稳定且稳健，并且在每个验证数据集中均优于其他模型。进行了孟德尔随机化分析。单核苷酸多态性（SNP）位点rs3100578（HK2）和rs66467677（HSP90B1）与膀胱问题（非癌症）和膀胱癌显著相关，而SNP位点rs3100578（HK2）和rs947939（BAD）与膀胱结石和膀胱癌相关。通过ESTIMATE（即利用表达数据估计恶性肿瘤中基质细胞和免疫细胞）算法计算了TCGA-BLCA队列的免疫浸润分析，该算法包含基质评分、免疫评分和估计评分。我们还发现，在高风险组和低风险组之间，Bortezomib_1191、Docetaxel_1007、Staurosporine_1034和Rapamycin_1084的IC(50)值存在显著差异。结论：总之，这些发现揭示了膀胱癌中失巢凋亡相关的预后基因，并构建了一种创新的机器学习模型AIDPS，对膀胱癌具有较高的预后价值。
